title: Boss: Zekrom, 3 HP bars (Factory -> Scrapyard on the 2nd break)
watch: The boss intro on the Factory field and the 3 small bar pips on Zekrom's databox (top left).
Garchomp's Earthquake empties bar 1: "A containment cable around the wild Zekrom snapped!", HP refills, one pip goes dark.
The Factory counts the quakes: "The gantries groan and buckle... (2 more)".
Dragon Claw empties bar 2: second cable snaps, Zekrom learns Bolt Strike, and the boss's break table changes the field.
An orange flash: "The Engine core buckles! The foundry floor collapses into scrap!" - now Scrapyard, whose scrap cuts Lucario on entry.
gif_watch: Dragon Claw empties Zekrom's second HP bar: the bar drains, "A containment cable ... snapped!", the bar refills and a pip goes dark.
Bar 2's break changes the field: orange flash, "The Engine core buckles! The foundry floor collapses into scrap!" (Factory -> Scrapyard).
keys: Boss intro: 3 bar pips lit on the EBDX boss databox
Bar 1 broken: HP hit 0, one pip goes dark
Bar 2's break changes the field: the Bridge's flash into Scrapyard
